shock_spec: Steel/aluminum proclamations remove country exemptions and set/revise additional duties to 25%; effective 2025-03-12.
notes: Useful identifying event because the legal shock is common but country exposure to covered products differs. Must map steel and aluminum scopes and country treatment point-in-time before use.

shock_spec: 10% baseline additional duty plus Annex-I country-specific rates scheduled for 2025-04-09, subject to enumerated product/country exceptions.
notes: High-priority event. Do not approximate with headline rate × total exports; Annex II and other exceptions must be removed from covered trade.

shock_spec: Country-specific Annex-I rates suspended to 10% for most partners while PRC rate increased to 125%, effective 2025-04-10.
notes: Treat as a new information-state event, not a revision applied retroactively to April 2.

shock_spec: Tariff letters announced new August-1 rates for multiple countries, including Japan 25%, Korea 25%, South Africa 30%, Kazakhstan 25%, Laos 40%, Malaysia 25%, Myanmar 40%, Tunisia 25%, Bosnia and Herzegovina 30%, Indonesia 32%.
notes: Use the information available in the July 7 letter batch. Later letters belong to later event clusters rather than being backfilled.

shock_spec: Executive Order 14326 set a new country-rate schedule for a broad set of partners, with non-listed countries generally at 10% and special EU treatment.
notes: Potentially strongest cross-sectional cluster after exact exceptions and prior-rate state are reconstructed. Shock must be change versus the legally prevailing rate, not the new tariff level.

shock_spec: Executive Order 14346 modified Annex II and expanded products excluded from reciprocal tariffs.
notes: A tariff-relief shock. PolicyImpact should be positive for countries exporting newly excluded products, based on point-in-time covered trade.

shock_spec: Executive Order 14389 ended certain IEEPA tariff actions covering multiple prior country and reciprocal-tariff programs.
notes: Useful reversal cluster, but only after the exact pre-termination tariff state and covered import base are reconstructed country by country.

shock_spec: 50% additional duty on 439 HTSUS8 provisions in Annex II.
notes: Exact PolicyImpact frozen at -0.4247525946% GDP-equivalent. Valid seed replay and audit row, but a single-country event does not identify the within-event cross-sectional transmission coefficient.
